CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stat_fb_ack (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, at double precision NOT NULL); -- Play time per save per Vietnam day (game/admin_stats.py "Thời gian chơi"), kept by the trigger -- stat_play_cmd on receipts (one receipt = one game command). Today's rows are updated on every -- command: room on each page for HOT updates (no index write) and an early vacuum. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stat_play ( day $145 NOT NULL, sid $146 NOT NULL, secs bigint NOT NULL, sessions bigint NOT NULL, cmds bigint NOT NULL, first_at double precision NOT NULL, last_at double precision NOT NULL, hours bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, sess_at double precision NOT NULL, lens $147 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (day, sid) ) WITH (fillfactor = 90, autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor = 0.01, autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor = 0.02); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stat_play_est (day $148 PRIMARY KEY, saves bigint NOT NULL, capped bigint NOT NULL, at double precision NOT NULL); -- One row per finished day of stat_play, written before its per-player rows are purged (kept forever). CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stat_rollups (kind $164 NOT NULL, day $165 NOT NULL, rows bigint NOT NULL, at double precision NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (kind, day)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stat_leaves ( id $166 PRIMARY KEY, sid $167 NOT NULL, at double precision NOT NULL, day $168 NOT NULL, payload $169 NOT NULL ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stat_leave_last (sid $170 PRIMARY KEY, at double precision NOT NULL, payload $171 NOT NULL) WITH (fillfactor = 80); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stat_client_errors ( day $172 NOT NULL, kind $173 NOT NULL, message_key $174 NOT NULL, screen $175 NOT NULL, count bigint NOT NULL, last_at double precision NOT NULL, sample $176, PRIMARY KEY (day, kind, message_key, screen) ); -- Bảng xếp hạng (game/leaderboard.py) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaderboard ( sid $190 NOT NULL, board $191 NOT NULL, score bigint NOT NULL, k1 bigint NOT NULL, k2 bigint NOT NULL, level bigint NOT NULL, days bigint NOT NULL, served bigint NOT NULL, stars bigint NOT NULL, mastered bigint NOT NULL, since double precision NOT NULL, updated double precision NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (sid, board) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS friends (sid $249 NOT NULL, friend $250 NOT NULL, since double precision NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (sid, friend)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS home_guest_invites ( id $251 PRIMARY KEY, owner $252 NOT NULL, guest $253 NOT NULL, home_id $254 NOT NULL, home_kind $255 NOT NULL, kind $256 NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('visit','stay')), status $257 NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','accepted','declined','revoked','left','expired')), created_at double precision NOT NULL, expires_at double precision, CHECK (owner <> guest) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS couple_moments ( id $277 PRIMARY KEY, couple bigint NOT NULL, sid $278 NOT NULL, kind $279 NOT NULL, text $280 NOT NULL, key $281 UNIQUE NOT NULL, at double precision NOT NULL, seen bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 ); -- 👶 Shared family, mutual invitations and surviving parents' private custody copies. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS family_children ( couple bigint PRIMARY KEY, state $282 NOT NULL, revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS family_custody ( child bigint NOT NULL, sid $283 NOT NULL, state $284 NOT NULL, revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (child,sid) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS family_requests ( id $285 PRIMARY KEY, couple bigint NOT NULL, from_sid $286 NOT NULL, to_sid $287 NOT NULL, kind $288 NOT NULL, data $289 NOT NULL, status $290 NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', at double precision NOT NULL ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS family_receipts ( sid $291 NOT NULL, rid $292 NOT NULL, op $293 NOT NULL, fingerprint $294 NOT NULL, result $295 NOT NULL, at double precision NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (sid,rid) ); -- 🎁 Quà từ Phố Có Chuyện (game/system_gift.py): a gift from the operator to one save, pending -> applied -> seen CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_gifts ( id $296 PRIMARY KEY, sid $297 NOT NULL, coins bigint NOT NULL, title $298 NOT NULL, text $299 NOT NULL, status $300 NOT NULL, created double precision NOT NULL, applied_at double precision, seen_at double precision, granted_by $301 ); -- granted_by: the admin account that gave it from /admin ("🎁 Tặng xu"); NULL for scripts/grant_gift.py and older rows. -- Added in 16 (nullable, no default: no table rewrite); earlier releases name their columns and never read it. ALTER TABLE system_gifts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS granted_by $302; -- 💬 Chat (the live service, live/; admin side in game/live_chat.py). Messages are kept: a player's own -- delete empties the text (deleted=1); reports and the admin hide (hidden 1 = auto-hidden after 3 reports, -- 2 = hidden by an admin) never remove a row. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_channels ( id $303 PRIMARY KEY, kind $304 NOT NULL, title $305 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', owner_pid $306, created double precision NOT NULL ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_members ( channel $307 NOT NULL, pid $308 NOT NULL, sid $309 NOT NULL, role $310 NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member', joined double precision NOT NULL, last_read bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, muted_until double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pushed_at double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (channel, pid) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages ( id $311 PRIMARY KEY, channel $312 NOT NULL, pid $313 NOT NULL, name $314 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', av $315 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', text $316 NOT NULL, at double precision NOT NULL, hidden bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, deleted bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reports bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reviewed_at double precision, adm bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, raw $317 ); -- adm = 1: written by an admin (ADMIN_USERS) on Cả phố. Added in 10 (a constant default: no table rewrite). ALTER TABLE chat_messages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS adm bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; -- raw: what the player typed when the filter masked part of it (NULL when the text is as typed). Admins only, -- never sent to players. Added in 11 (nullable, no default: no table rewrite); older rows stay NULL. -- Since 13 a message its author takes back (Thu hồi) after somebody reported it keeps its text here for the admin. ALTER TABLE chat_messages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS raw $318; ALTER TABLE chat_messages ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reply_to bigint; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_mutes ( pid $319 PRIMARY KEY, until double precision NOT NULL, by_admin $320 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', reason $321 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', at double precision NOT NULL ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_prefs (pid $322 PRIMARY KEY, online bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated double precision NOT NULL); -- 😍 Reactions (live/chat.py): one per player per message, replaced or removed by the player. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_reacts ( msg bigint NOT NULL, pid $323 NOT NULL, emoji $324 NOT NULL, at double precision NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (msg, pid) ); -- 📌 The pinned message of a channel (Cả phố only for now): one row, read by the live service by primary key. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_pins ( channel $325 PRIMARY KEY, msg bigint NOT NULL, by_pid $326 NOT NULL, at double precision NOT NULL ); -- 🙂 The face of a player's chat avatar (live/faces.py code of whitelisted ids), written by the live service only. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_faces (pid $327 PRIMARY KEY, code $328 NOT NULL, at double precision NOT NULL); -- 🗑️ Deleted on one side only (live/chat.py): a message a player removed from their own screen, and a whole chat -- emptied for one player (every message up to `upto`, the chat's newest id then). Nobody else's view changes; the -- messages themselves stay (admins still see them). Written by the live service only. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_hides (pid $329 NOT NULL, msg bigint NOT NULL, at double precision NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (pid, msg)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_clears ( channel $330 NOT NULL, pid $331 NOT NULL, upto bigint NOT NULL, at double precision NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (channel, pid) ); -- 🐢 Slow mode set by an admin (game/live_chat.py, read by live/chat.py; SCHEMA_VERSION 24): one player may post on -- Cả phố once per `every` seconds until `until`; the row with pid 'town' slows Cả phố for everyone. Never a ban. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_slow ( pid $332 PRIMARY KEY, every double precision NOT NULL, until double precision NOT NULL, by_admin $333 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', at double precision NOT NULL ); -- 🙏 Công đức Chùa Gió Lành (game/spend.py; SCHEMA_VERSION 25): one row per donation, written in the save's own -- transaction (id '<pid>:<n>', idempotent). The weekly board reads it by week. A player who erases their data stays -- on the board as anonymous (sid ''). CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS donations ( id $334 PRIMARY KEY, sid $335 NOT NULL, week $336 NOT NULL, amount bigint NOT NULL CHECK(amount > 0), wish $337 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', anon bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, at double precision NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS donations_week ON donations(week, sid); -- 🎨 Màu tên, khung hồ sơ, danh hiệu tuần worn now (game/spend.py writes it with the save; live/styles.py reads it by -- pid and shows it as `st` beside the name). An expired item is ignored by its `_until` (unix seconds). CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_style ( pid $338 PRIMARY KEY, sid $339 NOT NULL, color $340 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', color_until double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, frame $341 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', frame_until double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, title $342 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', title_until double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, at double precision NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS chat_style_sid ON chat_style(sid); -- Rewards the live service grants (phase 3 dates, phase 2 lucky envelopes); the game server applies them on load. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS live_effects ( id $343 PRIMARY KEY, sid $344 NOT NULL, kind $345 NOT NULL, amount bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, data $346 NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', status $347 NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', at double precision NOT NULL, applied_at double precision ); -- 💼 Hired players' shifts at someone's counter (game/quay_hire.py): one row per offer, guarded status changes. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quay_jobs ( id $348 PRIMARY KEY, owner $349 NOT NULL, owner_name $350 NOT NULL, stall $351 NOT NULL, stall_name $352 NOT NULL, trade $353 NOT NULL, place $354 NOT NULL, wage bigint NOT NULL, value bigint NOT NULL, friend $355, worker $356, status $357 NOT NULL, day $358 NOT NULL, taken_day $359, at double precision NOT NULL, taken_at double precision, ended double precision, until double precision NOT NULL, tasks bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, stars bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, earned bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 ); -- 💸 Transfers between friends (game/bank_xfer.py): one row per transfer (the audit log), guarded status changes; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quay_funding ( job $360 PRIMARY KEY, owner $361 NOT NULL, rid $362, fingerprint $363 NOT NULL, source $364 NOT NULL, couple bigint, UNIQUE(owner,rid) ); -- the day counters move with conditional upserts (the caps hold under concurrency). CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_xfers ( id $365 PRIMARY KEY, code $366 NOT NULL, sender $367 NOT NULL, receiver $368 NOT NULL, from_name $369 NOT NULL, to_name $370 NOT NULL, amount bigint NOT NULL, note $371 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', src $372 NOT NULL, status $373 NOT NULL, day $374 NOT NULL, at double precision NOT NULL, done_at double precision ); -- Prepaid player leases. Session rows are always locked before rental rows. CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rentals ( id $375 PRIMARY KEY, owner $376 NOT NULL, property $377 NOT NULL, kind $378 NOT NULL, owner_name $379 NOT NULL, tenant $380, tenant_name $381 NOT NULL DEFAULT '', rent bigint NOT NULL, status $382 NOT NULL, start_day bigint, end_day bigint, at double precision NOT NULL, updated double precision NOT NULL ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS rentals_property_active ON rentals(owner,property) WHERE status IN ('listing','leased'); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS rentals_tenant_active ON rentals(tenant) WHERE status='leased'; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS rentals_market ON rentals(status,at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS rentals_owner ON rentals(owner,at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS rentals_tenant ON rentals(tenant,status); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rental_closed_accounts (sid $383 PRIMARY KEY); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rental_receipts ( sid $384 NOT NULL, rid $385 NOT NULL, fingerprint $386 NOT NULL, result $387 NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(sid,rid) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bank_xfer_days ( sid $388 NOT NULL, day $389 NOT NULL, sent bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, n bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, got bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (sid, day) ); -- 💕 Dates of the live service (live/dating.py; game/live_dating.py): one row per café date (pids a < b), and the -- bond "đang tìm hiểu" of two saves (sids a < b) that both tapped ❤️.
